Name: NPCMaker
Author: slpOff
Description:
[b][/b][quote][b]NPC Maker 0.1.0[/b] lets you easily export your current farmer’s full animation sprite sheet for use in modding, editing, or creating NPCs.Each animation frame (walking, tool use, combat, and more) is automatically rendered and saved as a single PNG file.[/quote][b]﻿
How to Use[/b][list=1]
[*]Launch the game and load your save.
[*]Open the SMAPI console.
[*]Type the following command:[code]export_all <slotNumber>[/code]Example:[code]export_all 0[/code]
[*]The exported PNG file will appear in your mod folder under the [code]Generated[/code] directory.
[/list][line][i]Perfect for modders who want to turn their farmer into a custom NPC or create Stardew-style sprites![/i]
